summary: Anthropic's own catalogs (2,722 plugins: 315 official, 2,284 community, 123 knowledge-work) are now a trust layer: any tool listed there gets a gold badge and a small bonus. Added Anthropic's Small Business plugin (44 skills, v1.35.1), which Charlie spotted. Review: research/hands/reviews/anthropic-marketplaces-2026-10-09.md.

tools.name: Claude for Small Business
tools.what: Anthropic's plugin of 44 small-business skills: quotes from job photos, chasing invoices, review replies, a social posting calendar, a Monday cash brief. Works in GBP; asks before anything touches money or customers.
tools.quote: Pre-built small business workflows to help you run and grow your business. Supports a majority of the tools you already use. You approve every step that touches money or customers.
tools.check: Anthropic-made (knowledge-work-plugins, Apache 2.0, last commit 7 Oct 2026). UK tax isn't covered: tax-prep only builds a packet for your accountant. Desktop app (Cowork) or Claude Code; not confirmed on claude.ai web.

our_view.for_what: The decorating business (parked) and friends' set-ups in the set-up kit: proposal-builder, invoice-chase, review-reputation, social-content-engine
our_view.why: The decorating business is parked and the kit hasn't had its first set-up yet. Strong candidate to offer a small-business owner in the kit once it's tried with try-tool.

cost.amount: included with a paid Claude plan (Pro and up)
